using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        private class FakeRecoverLock
        {
            private readonly bool tryUpgradeReadLockResult;
            private readonly bool tryReadLockResult;
            private readonly bool tryWriteLockResult;

            public FakeRecoverLock(bool tryUpgradeReadLockResult, bool tryReadLockResult, bool tryWriteLockResult)
            {
                this.tryUpgradeReadLockResult = tryUpgradeReadLockResult;
                this.tryReadLockResult = tryReadLockResult;
                this.tryWriteLockResult = tryWriteLockResult;
            }

            public bool TryUpgradeReadLock() => tryUpgradeReadLockResult;
            public bool TryReadLock() => tryReadLockResult;
            public bool TryWriteLock() => tryWriteLockResult;
        }

        private class FakeStoreWrapper
        {
            private readonly bool tryPauseCheckpointsResult;
            public bool ResumeCheckpointsCalled { get; private set; }

            public FakeStoreWrapper(bool tryPauseCheckpointsResult)
            {
                this.tryPauseCheckpointsResult = tryPauseCheckpointsResult;
            }

            public bool TryPauseCheckpoints() => tryPauseCheckpointsResult;
            public void ResumeCheckpoints() => ResumeCheckpointsCalled = true;
        }

        private class FakeClusterProvider
        {
            public FakeStoreWrapper storeWrapper;

            public FakeClusterProvider(FakeStoreWrapper storeWrapper)
            {
                this.storeWrapper = storeWrapper;
            }
        }

        private class TestReplicationManager : ReplicationManager
        {
            public FakeRecoverLock FakeRecoverLock;
            public FakeClusterProvider FakeClusterProvider;

            public TestReplicationManager(FakeClusterProvider clusterProvider, ILogger logger)
                : base(clusterProvider, logger)
            {
                this.FakeClusterProvider = clusterProvider;
                this.FakeRecoverLock = null!;
            }

            public override bool BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus nextRecoveryStatus, bool upgradeLock)
            {
                // Override to use fake recoverLock and storeWrapper
                if (upgradeLock)
                {
                    if (!FakeRecoverLock.TryUpgradeReadLock())
                    {
                        return false;
                    }

                    currentRecoveryStatus = nextRecoveryStatus;
                    logger?.LogTrace("Upgraded recover lock [{recoverStatus}]", nextRecoveryStatus);
                    return true;
                }

                if (currentRecoveryStatus != RecoveryStatus.NoRecovery)
                {
                    logger?.LogError("Error background recovering task has not completed [{recoverStatus}]", nextRecoveryStatus);
                    return false;
                }

                if (!FakeClusterProvider.storeWrapper.TryPauseCheckpoints())
                {
                    logger?.LogError("Error could not acquire checkpoint lock [{recoverStatus}]", nextRecoveryStatus);
                    return false;
                }

                var lockAcquired =
                    nextRecoveryStatus == RecoveryStatus.ReadRole ?
                        FakeRecoverLock.TryReadLock() :
                        FakeRecoverLock.TryWriteLock();

                if (!lockAcquired)
                {
                    logger?.LogError("Error could not acquire recover lock [{recoverStatus}]", nextRecoveryStatus);
                    FakeClusterProvider.storeWrapper.ResumeCheckpoints();
                    return false;
                }

                currentRecoveryStatus = nextRecoveryStatus;
                logger?.LogTrace("Success recover lock [{recoverStatus}]", nextRecoveryStatus);
                return true;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_UpgradeLockFails_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(true);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object);
            manager.FakeRecoverLock = new FakeRecoverLock(false, true, true);

            bool result = manager.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.ReadRole, upgradeLock: true);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Trace,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                (Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>)It.IsAny<object>()), Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_CurrentRecoveryNotNoRecovery_LogsErrorAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(true);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object);
            manager.FakeRecoverLock = new FakeRecoverLock(true, true, true);
            manager.currentRecoveryStatus = RecoveryStatus.InitializeRecover;

            bool result = manager.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.ReadRole, upgradeLock: false);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError("Error background recovering task has not completed [{recoverStatus}]", RecoveryStatus.ReadRole), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_TryPauseCheckpointsFails_LogsErrorAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(false);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object);
            manager.FakeRecoverLock = new FakeRecoverLock(true, true, true);
            manager.currentRecoveryStatus = RecoveryStatus.NoRecovery;

            bool result = manager.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.ReadRole, upgradeLock: false);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError("Error could not acquire checkpoint lock [{recoverStatus}]", RecoveryStatus.ReadRole), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_TryReadLockFails_LogsErrorResumesCheckpointsAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(true);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object);
            manager.FakeRecoverLock = new FakeRecoverLock(true, false, true);
            manager.currentRecoveryStatus = RecoveryStatus.NoRecovery;

            bool result = manager.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.ReadRole, upgradeLock: false);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError("Error could not acquire recover lock [{recoverStatus}]", RecoveryStatus.ReadRole), Times.Once);
            Assert.True(storeWrapper.ResumeCheckpointsCalled);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_TryWriteLockFails_LogsErrorResumesCheckpointsAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(true);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object);
            manager.FakeRecoverLock = new FakeRecoverLock(true, true, false);
            manager.currentRecoveryStatus = RecoveryStatus.NoRecovery;

            bool result = manager.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.CheckpointRecoveredAtReplica, upgradeLock: false);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError("Error could not acquire recover lock [{recoverStatus}]", RecoveryStatus.CheckpointRecoveredAtReplica), Times.Once);
            Assert.True(storeWrapper.ResumeCheckpointsCalled);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_SuccessfulReadLock_LogsTraceAndReturnsTrue()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(true);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object);
            manager.FakeRecoverLock = new FakeRecoverLock(true, true, true);
            manager.currentRecoveryStatus = RecoveryStatus.NoRecovery;

            bool result = manager.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.ReadRole, upgradeLock: false);

            Assert.True(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogTrace("Success recover lock [{recoverStatus}]", RecoveryStatus.ReadRole), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_SuccessfulWriteLock_LogsTraceAndReturnsTrue()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(true);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object);
            manager.FakeRecoverLock = new FakeRecoverLock(true, true, true);
            manager.currentRecoveryStatus = RecoveryStatus.NoRecovery;

            bool result = manager.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.CheckpointRecoveredAtReplica, upgradeLock: false);

            Assert.True(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogTrace("Success recover lock [{recoverStatus}]", RecoveryStatus.CheckpointRecoveredAtReplica), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        // We cannot subclass ReplicationManager because it is internal sealed.
        // Instead, we will test the BeginRecovery method by creating a minimal mock environment
        // and using reflection to set private fields as needed.

        private class FakeStoreWrapper
        {
            private readonly bool tryPauseCheckpointsResult;
            public bool ResumeCheckpointsCalled { get; private set; }

            public FakeStoreWrapper(bool tryPauseCheckpointsResult)
            {
                this.tryPauseCheckpointsResult = tryPauseCheckpointsResult;
            }

            public bool TryPauseCheckpoints() => tryPauseCheckpointsResult;
            public void ResumeCheckpoints() => ResumeCheckpointsCalled = true;
        }

        private class FakeClusterProvider
        {
            public FakeStoreWrapper storeWrapper;

            public FakeClusterProvider(FakeStoreWrapper storeWrapper)
            {
                this.storeWrapper = storeWrapper;
            }
        }

        private static void SetPrivateField(object obj, string fieldName, object value)
        {
            var type = obj.GetType();
            var field = type.GetField(fieldName, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (field == null)
                throw new Exception($"Field '{fieldName}' not found on type {type.FullName}");
            field.SetValue(obj, value);
        }

        private static object GetPrivateField(object obj, string fieldName)
        {
            var type = obj.GetType();
            var field = type.GetField(fieldName, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (field == null)
                throw new Exception($"Field '{fieldName}' not found on type {type.FullName}");
            return field.GetValue(obj);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BeginRecovery_LogsErrorWhenCurrentRecoveryNotNoRecovery()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var storeWrapper = new FakeStoreWrapper(true);
            var clusterProvider = new FakeClusterProvider(storeWrapper);

            // Create ReplicationManager instance via reflection since constructor is internal
            var type = typeof(ReplicationManager);
            var ctor = type.GetConstructor(
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic,
                null,
                new Type[] { clusterProvider.GetType(), typeof(ILogger) },
                null);
            if (ctor == null)
            {
                // Try public constructor with ClusterProvider and ILogger
                ctor = type.GetConstructor(
                    System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public,
                    null,
                    new Type[] { clusterProvider.GetType(), typeof(ILogger) },
                    null);
            }
            Assert.NotNull(ctor);

            var manager = (ReplicationManager)ctor.Invoke(new object[] { clusterProvider, loggerMock.Object });

            // Set currentRecoveryStatus to something other than NoRecovery
            SetPrivateField(manager, "currentRecoveryStatus", (RecoveryStatus)1); // Assume 1 != NoRecovery

            // Call BeginRecovery with upgradeLock = false
            var method = type.GetMethod("BeginRecovery", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            var result = (bool)method.Invoke(manager, new object[] { RecoveryStatus.ReadRole, false });

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError("Error background recovering task has not completed [{recoverStatus}]", RecoveryStatus.ReadRole), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
